cues.speaker: Mark
cues.en: Good morning! Are you new here?

cues.speaker: Jiwoo
cues.en: Yes, it's my first day. I'm Jiwoo.

cues.speaker: Mark
cues.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Mark, the team leader.

cues.speaker: Jiwoo
cues.en: Oh! Nice to meet you, too. I'm a little nervous.

cues.speaker: Mark
cues.en: Don't worry. Everyone is friendly.

cues.speaker: Mark
cues.en: Let's grab a coffee before the meeting.

cues.speaker: Jiwoo
cues.en: Sounds good. Thank you so much!

cues.speaker: Mark
cues.en: The meeting starts at ten. The coffee is on me!

cues.speaker: Jiwoo
cues.en: Wow, thanks! I'm not nervous anymore.
cues.ko: 와, 감사해요! 이제 긴장 안 돼요.

cues.speaker: Emma
cues.en: Oh no. It's raining, and I don't have an umbrella.

cues.speaker: Hajun
cues.en: Where are you going?

cues.speaker: Emma
cues.en: To the library. It's next to the park.

cues.speaker: Hajun
cues.en: Me too! We can share my umbrella.

cues.speaker: Emma
cues.en: Really? Are you sure?

cues.speaker: Hajun
cues.en: Of course. No big deal.

cues.speaker: Emma
cues.en: Thank you. You're so kind.

cues.speaker: Hajun
cues.en: Here we are. The library is right there.

cues.speaker: Emma
cues.en: Thanks again! Have a good day.
cues.ko: 다시 한번 고마워요! 좋은 하루 보내세요.

cues.speaker: Baker
cues.en: Hi there! What can I get for you?

cues.speaker: Minho
cues.en: I'd like a chocolate cake. It's my friend's birthday.

cues.speaker: Baker
cues.en: I'm sorry. We ran out of chocolate cake.

cues.speaker: Minho
cues.en: Oh no. What do you recommend?

cues.speaker: Baker
cues.en: The strawberry cake is very popular.

cues.speaker: Minho
cues.en: Great. I'll take it. Can you write "Happy Birthday, Sora"?
cues.ko: 좋아요. 그걸로 할게요. "생일 축하해, 소라"라고 써 주실 수 있어요?

cues.speaker: Baker
cues.en: Sure. It will be ready in ten minutes.

cues.speaker: Minho
cues.en: Perfect. Can I pay by card?

cues.speaker: Baker
cues.en: Of course. I hope your friend loves it!
